title: Public Creator Handle Resolution Operation
summary: Resolve a public creator-facing read model from a requested Sesh handle using only the canonical handle reservation and creator profile repositories.
invariants: The requested handle is normalized with the locked Sesh handle grammar before persistence access.
The canonical handle reservation row is the only source of handle ownership truth.
The creator profile is loaded only through the SeshCreatorId stored in the canonical reservation.
Persisted SeshCreatorProfile.handle is never trusted or returned as handle ownership truth.
The returned handle always comes from the canonical reservation.
The public read model does not expose SeshCreatorId, PrincipalId, account identity, session identity, CRM identity, creation timestamps, persistence revisions, or storage metadata.
A reservation whose normalized handle contradicts the requested canonical handle fails closed as unavailable.
Missing profile for an otherwise valid reservation returns not-found.
A profile whose creator id contradicts the reservation fails closed as unavailable.
Persistence validation, conflict, storage failure, or thrown repository errors fail closed as unavailable.
The operation grants no project ownership, collaboration, publishing, management, legal, copyright, CRM, account, authentication, or authorization rights.
This step exposes no HTTP endpoint, vanity route, handle availability endpoint, release operation, or rename operation.
